## Overview

ChittorTech is India's leading offshore IT company and software development agency headquartered in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, India. We are recognized by the Government of Rajasthan (iStart Q-Rate Startup), MSME Udyam certified, and serve international clients across the **USA, United Kingdom, Canada, UAE (Dubai & Abu Dhabi), Australia, Germany, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar**.

We specialize in building ultra-fast web applications (Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4), cross-platform mobile apps (React Native / Kotlin), SaaS platforms, custom AI chatbots (OpenAI GPT-4o, Groq SDK, Llama 3), and e-commerce systems with international payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay).

---

## Core Services for International Clients

### 1. Offshore Web App Development (Next.js / React)
- Premium, SEO-optimized, lightning-fast web applications built with Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4.
- Includes SSR, SSG, ISR, API routes, Firebase backend, and full deployment on Vercel/AWS.
- Fixed-price projects starting from **$500 USD**.
- Suitable for: USA startups, UK SaaS companies, Canadian e-commerce portals.

### 2. Cross-Platform Mobile App Engineering (React Native / Kotlin)
- High-performance native Android & iOS mobile apps using React Native (Expo) and Kotlin Jetpack Compose.
- Firebase integration, push notifications, offline storage, Play Store & App Store publishing.
- Fixed-price starting from **$1,000 USD**.
- Serving clients in USA, UAE, Australia, and Germany.

### 3. Custom AI & RAG Solutions (OpenAI / Groq / Llama 3)
- Bespoke AI chatbots, document Q&A engines, and automated workflows using OpenAI GPT-4o, Groq SDK, and Llama 3 models.
- Custom vector database embeddings and REST API integrations.
- Starting from **$800 USD**.
- Used by Dubai businesses, UK SaaS startups, and US enterprise clients.

### 4. SaaS MVP Development
- Full-stack multi-tenant SaaS architecture, billing integrations (Stripe), admin dashboards, and role-based access control.
- Ideal for startup founders in the USA, UK, and Canada looking to launch fast.
- Starting from **$1,500 USD**.

### 5. E-Commerce Development
- International online stores with Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay, and Cashfree payment gateways.
- Multi-currency support, inventory management, and automated invoice delivery.
- Serving UAE, Australian, US, and UK businesses.

### 6. Dedicated Remote Developers & Staff Augmentation
- Hire dedicated full-stack (Next.js/React), mobile (React Native/Kotlin), or AI developers on hourly or monthly contracts.
- Daily standups, GitHub-based transparent delivery, and timezone-compatible communication (IST +5:30).
- Hourly rate starting from **$15/hr USD**.
